exposure: esketamine combined with comprehensive nursing intervention
traditional treatment and routine nursing care (control)
cohort: The study participants were 140 women who underwent cesarean section at The Second Hospital of Dalian Medical University between May 2021 and May 2022.
finding: The application of esketamine combined with comprehensive nursing intervention after cesarean section significantly reduced postoperative pain and postpartum depression, improved physiological recovery, and enhanced quality of life compared to traditional treatment and routine nursing.
